hypothesis: At the identical Core Carry checkpoint, conditioning the complete exact-bracket YES ladder on outcomes still physically feasible after the observed running maximum supplies incremental information about whether the current exact bracket will remain the final winner.

target.label: 1 iff the final winning exact bracket equals the current bracket at decision time
target.primary_grain: first checkpoint per city x target_date x current_bracket state

denominator.snapshot_contract: Use only the exact archived orderbook_file named by each parent row. Never substitute a later snapshot.
denominator.coverage_rule: Missing snapshot, missing current rung, fewer than four YES rungs, or no upper rung is an evidence coverage gap rather than a strategy exclusion. Boundary midpoint uses missing bid=0 and missing ask=1 only when the opposite side exists; direct two-sided coverage is reported separately.

market_features.feature_book_clock: the parent row's exact decision-time orderbook snapshot

definitions.p_ladder_feasible_hold: current YES midpoint / (current YES midpoint + sum of all higher-rung YES midpoints); already-impossible lower rungs are excluded
definitions.far_vs_adjacent_upper_log_ratio: log((upper mass beyond the nearest higher rung + eps) / (nearest-higher-rung mass + eps))

baselines: frozen Core Carry v2 no-observation-age probability
models.primary_challenger: logit(p) = logit(p_core) + intercept + beta_shift * feasible_prior_shift + beta_tail * far_vs_adjacent_upper_log_ratio
models.constraints: beta_shift >= 0; beta_tail <= 0; fixed L2=0.2; intercept weak L2=0.01; no feature or penalty selection after results

acceptance_gates.historical_probability: On the historical secondary holdout, challenger minus frozen Core has negative date-equal Brier and logloss and both target-date bootstrap CI upper bounds are below zero.
acceptance_gates.market_baseline: On identical rows, challenger minus raw market has negative date-equal Brier and logloss.
acceptance_gates.coverage: At least 80% of parent checkpoints and at least 24 independent target dates have scorable full-ladder evidence.
acceptance_gates.clean_forward: Not available at preregistration. No shadow/live promotion is permitted from this run even if historical gates pass. A later clean-forward start must be registered separately.
acceptance_gates.execution: Only run a fee/depth expression replay if the probability and market-baseline gates pass; otherwise stop at model diagnosis.

out_of_scope: maker policy, sizing, eligibility, or production changes
